title: Sweet Potato and Cashew Soup
blurb: A smooth, gently spiced soup with roasted sweet potato, ground cashews and paprika, finished with crisp bread croutons.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and cut the sweet potato into chunks, then toss with half the olive oil and roast for 25 minutes until tender and starting to caramelise.
Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and garlic, then soften them in a saucepan with the remaining oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and cashews, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Add the roasted sweet potato and vegetable stock to the pan, bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Blend the soup until completely smooth, then season with salt to taste.
Tear the bread into rough pieces, toast under the grill until golden and crisp, then scatter over the soup to serve.
